create.name: Vrážné Zen Center (Seon Mun Sa)
create.bio:
Seon Mun Sa, the Zen centre in the village of Vrážné in Moravia, serves as the Czech head temple of the Kwan Um School of Zen and the school's only residential centre in the country. It belongs to the worldwide network of more than a hundred centres and groups that follow the Korean Zen Master Seung Sahn, whose teaching asks the simple question 'What am I?' and invites students to keep a 'don't know' mind in bowing, chanting and sitting as much as in daily tasks. George (Jiří) Hazlbauer JDPSN is the abbot.

The temple stands in the Moravian countryside, reached from Brno, Olomouc or Prague by bus or train via Chornice or Jevíčko, and it hosts retreats through the year. Its best-known event is a three-week winter retreat in silence, which can be joined for one to three weeks, with a different Kwan Um teacher leading each week; participants are expected to know the school's forms and to have sat a weekend retreat first. In 2023 the European Kwan Um School ran a fundraising campaign to finish a new kitchen at the centre, and its small YouTube channel holds recorded dharma talks by senior teachers of the school.

courses.title: Winter three-week retreat in Vrážné
courses.description: A silent winter retreat of sitting, chanting, walking and bowing at the temple, joined for one, two or three weeks, with George Hazlbauer, Knud Rosenmayr and Dušan Silváši (all JDPSN) each leading a week. Vegetarian meals; prior Kwan Um retreat experience required.
courses.price: One week: 6 200 CZK (250 EUR) / 4 700 CZK (190 EUR) / 4 200 CZK (170 EUR)
